extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.69[CR]- Discard unsuccessful Windows HDCP sessions before playback instead of retaining failed sessions until Stop.[CR]- After failed preparation, answer native status queries as unknown without repeating an automatic HDCP probe; preserve explicit protection requests from the genuine CDM.[CR]- Queue the return to the catalog asynchronously and retain the existing readiness acknowledgement.[CR]- Scope failed-preparation policy to the selected playback and release its owned DLL reference safely; record request origin, desired protection mask and display environment.[CR]- Retain native HD in stock Kodi, persistent pinned Chrome reuse, catalog and Watchlist improvements, and all accumulated fixes.
